notes.title: Version 0.1.18
notes.notes:
🛠️ Patch Notes — Version 0.1.8

🎨 Visual & Design Updates

 Old Forest portal redesign: Updated the design of the portal connecting the Old Forest to the Swamp, enhancing its visual clarity and style.
 Final version of the first introduction cinematic: The opening cinematic for the game has been finalized and updated to its definitive version.

⚙️ Gameplay Improvements

 Automatic input detection: The game now automatically detects when switching between controller and keyboard/mouse input.
 Water fall damage adjustment: Falling into water no longer causes an instant death. Instead, Helena now loses only 1 health point.
 Stage name indicator: Added a UI indicator that displays the current stage name when transitioning between stages.

🎬 Cinematic Controls

 Hold-to-skip introduction cinematic: Players can now hold a skip button to bypass the introduction cinematic when starting a new game.

 Enemy respawn system refactored: Enemies have been reworked to automatically respawn after a certain period, improving game flow and challenge balance.

notes.title: Version 0.1.14
notes.notes:
🛠️ Patch Notes — Version 0.1.14

✨ New Features

 Tree destruction effect in swamp levels: Trees in swamp areas can now be destroyed, adding more realism and environmental interaction.

🎬 Cinematic Improvements

 Transitions at the beginning and end of cinematics: Smooth transitions have been added to enhance the flow of narrative sequences.
 General cinematic adjustments: Visual and pacing improvements have been made across several scenes for a more cohesive and polished cinematic experience.

🗣️ Narrative Content

 Updated dialogues in the Old Forest: Dialogues in this area have been revised to improve story coherence and character development.

💡 Fixes

 Platform Lighting in the Salamander Boss stage: Fixed lighting issues on the platforms during this boss fight to improve visibility.

notes.title: Version 0.1.13
notes.notes:
🛠️ Patch Notes – Version 0.1.3


🎮 General Improvements

 Improved the jump platform programming for better responsiveness and accuracy during interaction.
 Enhanced the settings menu layout for clearer and more user-friendly navigation.

🐞 Bug Fixes

 Fixed a camera issue in Stage 8 of the Old Forest that caused visibility problems in certain areas.
 Resolved an issue where entering cutscenes while attacking with Helena caused unintended behavior.
 Fixed Helena’s movement animation, which now behaves correctly in all situations.

notes.title: New version 0.1.2
notes.notes:
🛠️ Patch Notes – Version 0.1.2


✨ New Features

 Intro video added: Players will now see a new cinematic introduction when starting the game, setting the tone for the adventure.
 New transition cinematic: A new scene has been added to narratively connect the Old Forest chapter with the Swamp, enhancing story continuity.

🎮 Gameplay

 Auto-jump platforms: New platforms have been implemented that allow the character to jump automatically, improving flow in certain sections of the game.

🧍‍♂️ Animations

 Character animation improvements: Several animations have been refined and polished to achieve smoother and more realistic movement.

🖱️ Controls

 Mouse speed adjustments: Mouse sensitivity has been calibrated to provide a more precise and comfortable experience.
